manifest.name: dsh-config-guard

scripts.check: node --check lib/index.js && node --check lib/client.js && node --check lib/routes.js

manifest.description: Read-only configuration-inheritance and workspace-health reporter for DeepSeek Harness
manifest.author: xiaojieli

bundle.text:
# dsh-config-guard bundle patch: one row, inert until the user opens the
# settings page (mode: report). The plugin never edits this file itself.
- insert:
    - id: config-guard
      name: dsh-config-guard
      config:
        enabled: true
        mode: report

一个 DSH 设置页插件：把「配置继承」讲清楚——profile 覆盖了哪些行、升级会悄悄丢掉什么、
工作区资产有多大、工具到底用得多不多。

**只读。** 不写配置、不落状态文件、不导出凭证、不发外部网络请求；只呈现宿主已经知道的东西。

> 截图使用**示例数据**（插件 id、体积、调用次数均为脱敏构造），不是任何人的真实配置。

- **升级后新选项为什么没生效？** 每行标注 `完全继承 / 需补齐 / 已钉住 / 第三方行`，并列出缺失的键。
- **升级会丢掉什么？** 需要补齐的行数，加上版本钉住的依赖与未启用的 bundle。
- **工作区有多大？** 20 类资产的文件数与体积；冲突检查（孤儿配置行、失效 `link:`、
  已被移除的 bundle、明文密钥、未登记技能）。
- **这些工具我真的在用吗？** 用宿主自己的会话聚合缓存统计工具调用次数（覆盖窗口、会话数、
  高频工具、在用模型），不读消息正文。
- **工作区健不健康？** 0–100 分，建议只有文字，没有执行按钮。

```sh
node install.mjs --profile desktop

```

`--uninstall` 卸载，`--dry-run` 只打印计划。

读：`cordis.patch.yml`、profile 的 `package.json`、`ctx.configEditor.configuration()`、资产目录，
以及 `~/.dsh/storages/session_projcache/sessions/*.json` 里的按日工具计数（无消息正文、无会话回放）。

写：无。`lib/` 里没有 `writeFileSync` / `copyFileSync` / `rmSync`，没有 `configEditor.edit`，
卸载后不留痕迹。两个 GET 接口：`/config-guard/state`、`/config-guard/assets`；
其它方法一律 405，未知路径一律 404。

完整版（本仓库 `scripts/dsh-config-guard/`）可以逐项补齐、临时关闭、导出/导入迁移包。
本发布树只保留检查能力：没有写路径模块、没有状态文件、没有 UI 写入控件。
`test/readonly.test.js` 把这一点钉死：非 GET 请求被拒、一次完整读取不改动 profile 目录、
`lib/index.js` 出现写入符号或 `lib/pack.js` 出现即失败。

```sh
node --test test/*.test.js   # 38 项
node test/smoke.mjs          # 只读冒烟：GET 通过、非 GET 被拒、profile 目录零新增
```

readme.text:
完整版会滚动快照 profile 的 `package.json`（bundle 名单）、`cordis.patch.yml`、`preset-overrides.json`，
并与上一份对比，把「bundle 名单变短」「patch 体量骤降」「connection 行缺失 / cookie 寿命过长 /
cookie 罐接近 16 KiB 头限制」直接报成检查项。**本只读版不写快照**：它读完整版留下的快照做对比，
新装环境只有静态不变量检查；cookie 计数是对桌面端 `Cookies` 库的一次只读聚合查询，
打不开就标为不可用，不会抛错。

1. **GitHub 仓库打 `dsh-plugin` topic**。`github.com/topics/dsh-plugin` 本身是发现页（当前 2.7 万+ 仓库），
   目录站的自动收集就是靠这个 topic 找到你；不打 topic，手动提交也能收录，但不会被自动发现。
2. **发布到 npm**（名字 `dsh-config-guard` 目前可用）。目录站只从 npm 安装，未发布的收录是「仅浏览」，
   详情页没有安装命令。
3. **向 [`imsai-sh/awesome-deepseek-harness-plugins`](https://github.com/imsai-sh/awesome-deepseek-harness-plugins)
   提一个只新增 `catalog/plugins/<owner>--<repo>.json` 的 PR**。静态审查只读仓库、
   校验 `package.json` 的 `dsh.bundle.patch` 和 patch 文件确实在树里（本仓库 `test/package.test.js` 提前镜像了这道检查），
   通过后自动 squash 合并，随后同步到 deepseek1024.com 与目录 README。
   条目模板见 `catalog/plugins.json.example`，分类取 `dev`（开发与运行时）。
`README.build.md` 记录了本发布树与完整版的差异。

A settings-page plugin for DeepSeek Harness that makes configuration inheritance visible: which
rows your profile overrides, what an upgrade would silently drop, how big your workspace assets are,
and which tools you actually use.

**Read-only.** No configuration writes, no state file, no credential export, no network calls. It
only shows what the host already knows.

> The screenshot uses **sample data** (plugin ids, sizes and call counts are made up and
> sanitised), not anyone's real configuration.

- **Why did a new option not apply after an upgrade?** Rows are labelled
  `inherited / needs restore / pinned / third-party`, with the missing keys listed.
- **What would an upgrade drop?** The count of rows needing a restore, plus pinned dependencies and
  inactive bundles.
- **How big is my workspace?** 20 asset families with size and file counts, plus conflict findings
  (orphan config rows, dangling links, removed bundles, plaintext secrets).
- **Do I actually use this?** Tool-call counts aggregated by the host's own session activity cache —
  coverage window, sessions, top tools, models in use.
- **Is the workspace healthy?** A 0-100 score with advice-only suggestions.

```bash
git clone https://github.com/lixiaojie/dsh-config-guard.git
node dsh-config-guard/install.mjs --profile desktop

readme.section: restart DSH, then Settings → Config inheritance guard
readme.text:
```

`--uninstall` removes it again; `--dry-run` prints the plan without touching anything.

Reads: `cordis.patch.yml`, the profile manifest, `ctx.configEditor.configuration()`, asset directories,
and the per-day tool-call counters in `~/.dsh/storages/session_projcache/sessions/*.json`
(no message bodies, no session replay).

Writes: nothing. There is no `writeFileSync` in the shipped code and an uninstall leaves no trace.

Network: none. The card only calls two same-origin GET endpoints.

| Method | Path | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| GET | `/config-guard/state` | Full snapshot: inventory, compatibility, assets, health, suggestions, usage |
| GET | `/config-guard/assets` | Assets only |

Anything non-GET returns `405`; unknown paths `404`; cross-origin requests `403`.

It requires the `webServer`, `configEditor`, `pluginManager` and `appReady` services (0.2.1-rc.5+).
A host without them will not activate the plugin — this build does not half-load. Every call site is
still guarded: if a service exists but throws, the card degrades to what it could read and says so.
These services are not part of a documented public SDK yet — treat the version range in
`dsh.compatibility` as a declaration, not a guarantee.
